feedback.topic: Visa stablecoin settlement doubles to $7B run rate
feedback.source_headline: Visa (V) expands stablecoin settlement network as volume hits $7 billion run rate
feedback.post_preview: Visa's stablecoin settlement hit a $7 billion annualized run rate this week, double the $3.5 billion recorded in December. The network now covers 9 blockchains and 130 card programs across 50 countrie
